decoded.meaning: ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0030 (tr::schema::type_mismatch) } — the answer to a creator-endpoint connection SPEC whose config names no `kind` and matches no staged link
decoded.note: Pins the RFC-0014 §2 error identity for the kind-less-SPEC case (#1062): an incomplete config is a missing REQUIRED FIELD (the addr/port precedent), answered `tr::schema::type_mismatch` — never `tr::path::not_found` (0x0020), which RFC-0014 reserves for an ABSENT creator endpoint (the creatability probe). First child VALUE holds the u16 LE registered code; no detail children.
